_about: Public-domain A. N. Mouravieff (Andrei Nikolaevich Muravyov, 1806-1874), Russian church historian and Under-Procurator of the Holy Synod, in English translation for the Word Hoard: A History of the Church of Russia, tr. R. W. Blackmore (Oxford: Parker, 1842), from an Internet Archive scan. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 35 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

mouravieff-church-of-russia: A History of the Church of Russia, tr. R. W. Blackmore (Oxford: John Henry Parker; London: Rivingtons, 1842)

_alternates.mouravieff-copies: The London issue (Joseph Masters, 1842) and another Oxford copy; Neale's Voices from the East (1859), whose first six essays are Mouravieff's, though the title page does not name him

_excluded.mouravieff-other: The 1971 AMS reprint; French editions; Boris Mouravieff, a different author
